fieldNotes.siteResolution: Resolved to the BlueTriton / Nestle Waters North America (now Primo Brands) Sacramento bottling plant at 8670 Younger Creek Dr, Sacramento CA 95828 (APN 062-0140-013, Lots 21-22 Florin Depot Industrial Park, ~29 acres parcel). Confirmed by Yelp/OpenGovUS/D&B business registrations for Nestle Waters USA at that address and a 2009 Sacramento Press report (Nestle retrofit, ~214,000 sqft building, $14M, two production lines, 40 jobs, Pure Life + Arrowhead bottling). The supplied city-level coords (38.5158,-121.3809) geocode to this exact address - they were correct, not off. IGNORED the San Bernardino spring-extraction site per brief; this is the production/bottling plant. Locked coords to the building center 38.51615,-121.38055.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large single-mass rectangular bottling/warehouse building (long axis ~N40W, rotated ~30deg from north) on a fenced lot, yard wrapping the NW/SW/SE sides. Counted as 1.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. z21 satellite (p18-gate-z21) shows a cantilever SLIDING GATE spanning the entrance drive on the NE/E side at ~38.51665,-121.37945, set behind a curved apron off the access road, with a gate-motor box on the north post. Street View 2025-03 (pano jvqRTVLuhkw3sOT7GfJGpw, heading 270) confirms continuous chain-link perimeter fencing and a sliding gate across the controlled truck/vehicle entrance, dock doors with blue dock equipment and trailers behind the fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No staffed booth (1-3 vehicle footprint, multi-side windows) beside the gate in satellite or Street View. The entrance is an unmanned sliding gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: TRUE. There is a controlled truck gate but no guard shack -> implies kiosk / call-box / badge / app check-in (remote gate).
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: TRUE. Single controlled gate point on the NE side handles both directions; pavement near the gate carries an 'OUT' marking but it is the same gate group (p18-docks-mid-z20).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: One inbound lane at the sliding gate. exitLanes assumed 1 (same gate, OUT marking) - low confidence on lane split.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: TRUE. Wide wrapping internal yard drive from the gate to the SW dock bank easily stacks 3+ trucks; deep paved approach.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE. Large open paved yard inside the fence between the gate and the dock face serves as an internal staging/queue area.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: FALSE. No dedicated paved waiting apron outside the gate on the public road.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Band 25-50. Continuous dock bank along the SW building face with trailers backed in (p18-docks-sw-z20 shows ~12-15 trailers in one segment; p18-sw-corner-z20 and z17 show the bank continuing). A smaller dock/load cluster sits on the NE face. Honest total ~30; banded 25-50. Flagged uncertain - exact count not resolvable from overhead.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: TRUE (medium confidence). A primary dock bank on the SW face plus a secondary dock/load cluster on the NE face = two distinct dock banks on different building faces, consistent with split ship/receive. Function not confirmable from imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Band 10-25. Trailers parked without tractors staged in the NE/N yard drop area and along the dock apron (~12-18 visible). Banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE. The wrapping NE/N yard holds dropped trailers separate from the active SW dock staging.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~12-15 backed at the SW docks + ~6-8 staged/dropped in the wrapping yard = ~22. Approximate from mixed-vintage tiles.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Wrapping perimeter yard + dock apron could practically hold ~40 trailers.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~17.1 acres of fenced/paved operational footprint derived from the perimeter polygon. The platted parcel (Lots 21-22) is ~29 acres but includes adjoining undeveloped/peripheral land; the active fenced yard is ~17 acres.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban. Dense Florin/Power Inn / Florin-Fruitridge industrial fabric inside the Sacramento metro, surrounded on all sides by warehouses and arterials.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: FALSE. Dense metro industrial park - strong cellular coverage expected.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: FALSE. The gate sits off an internal industrial street (Younger Creek Dr) with a deep internal yard; a queue would not spill onto a public arterial or block an intersection.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: FALSE. Single gate lane on a normal-width drive; no obvious unused paved width or 3+ lane apron for an express bypass.
fieldNotes.scale: FALSE. No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path.
fieldNotes.multiStep: FALSE. Single gate checkpoint; no second booth/scale stage before the docks.
fieldNotes.railServed: FALSE. Rail corridors run alongside the district to the NW and E but no spur enters this property.
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Gate pano jvqRTVLuhkw3sOT7GfJGpw (38.51666,-121.37936, 2025-03) faces the sliding-gate entrance at heading 270. Perimeter pano qn9AUmi2157-fqRKne6Mlw (38.51644,-121.37915, 2025-03) on the NE road faces the building/yard at heading 255.
